title: SKE Crystal Pro Lemon & Lime Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy the brand’s standout flavours without the waste and expense of disposable vapes. Each prefilled pod provides up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, delivering a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Lemon & Lime is a bold and zesty citrus blend that balances the sharp tang of lemon with the smooth, refreshing bite of lime. The lively citrus notes create a crisp and energising vape, offering a clean and uplifting exhale that refreshes the palate. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and click a fresh one into place. Whether you’re looking for a simple alternative to disposables or a reliable way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a mess-free and flavour-packed vaping experience.
